title: Guaranteed Purchase and Appraisal Figures — In-Place Home Resale
content:
**In-Place Home Resale — guaranteed purchase schedule.** Hearthstone guarantees to buy a home that does not sell within its listing term only on the Guaranteed Resale Program. The figures of the guarantee are:

| Package | Guarantee offered | Guaranteed purchase price (percent of the appraised value) | Independent appraisal fee (USD) | Appraisal valid for the guaranteed price (calendar days) | Highest list price (percent of the appraised value) | Guaranteed purchase closes within (calendar days after the listing term ends) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Resale Approval Service | No | not applicable | not applicable | not applicable | not applicable | not applicable |
| Owner-Marketed Listing Package | No | not applicable | not applicable | not applicable | not applicable | not applicable |
| Assisted Resale Listing | No | not applicable | not applicable | not applicable | not applicable | not applicable |
| Full-Service Resale Brokerage | No | not applicable | not applicable | not applicable | not applicable | not applicable |
| Full-Service Resale Brokerage Plus | No | not applicable | not applicable | not applicable | not applicable | not applicable |
| Guaranteed Resale Program | Yes | 85.00 | 450.00 | 180 | 110.00 | 30 |

**Reading the percentages (hypothetical appraisal).** For a home appraised at 80000.00 on the Guaranteed Resale Program, 85.00 percent of the appraised value is 68000.00 and 110.00 percent is 88000.00.
